The seminar meets **Wednesdays, 4:30–5:30 pm** in
[CoDA E160](https://campus-map.stanford.edu/?srch=CoDA), in person only.
Each talk below states its room, and any talk held elsewhere is flagged.

::: {.callout-warning title="Two talks meet in a different room"}
The **September 23** and **October 7** talks are in
[**Packard 101**](https://campus-map.stanford.edu/?srch=Packard), not CoDA
E160. All other talks are in CoDA E160 as usual.
:::

Any changes to the schedule will be reflected here, so check this page often.
Or [subscribe](subscribe.qmd) and we will send you the coming week's talk every
Sunday.

::: {#talks}
